title: Agent documents and base prompts
what: The documents each Claude process is given, where they stand under prompts/agents, how they compose into a system prompt, and the base prompts the owner keeps in place of a harness prompt.

title: Executions
what: Every run of an agent's process agency records: its execution row and attempts across the boundary, the cancellations a stopped run takes back, and the rows closed on evidence.

title: The agent and its session contract
what: What an agent is and how every one of them is reached through the agent-session contract, its eleven operations, and the conversational agents as their rows declare them.

title: What each agent owns
what: The state each designated agent keeps apart from the others, its sessions, memories, watches, room notes, rulebooks and gate settings, and the agents table agency holds.

title: Agent roles
what: The roles an agent may hold and the function bundles each one gives its turns, as the policy declares them.
